ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the schematic diagram of the water cycle. <image1> “Cloud qi travels west, cloudy and so, uninterrupted in winter and summer; water springs flow east, day and night without rest, above not exhausted, below not full...” Which water-cycle links in the figure are mainly involved in this passage? ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The left side of the figure is land, a hillside, and a lake; the right side is the ocean, and there are two clouds above. Numbered arrows indicate water-cycle processes: ① is a horizontal arrow high in the sky pointing from the cloud above the ocean on the right to the cloud above the land on the left; ② is a downward precipitation arrow from the cloud above the ocean; ③ is an upward evaporation arrow from the ocean; ④ near the land lake indicates a vertical water vapor or precipitation process; ⑤ is an arrow flowing along the land slope to the right, toward the ocean; ⑥ is a groundwater or spring-water runoff arrow below the land from left to right. Then reason: In the question stem, “cloud qi travels west” indicates that clouds and water vapor are transported westward, corresponding to the high-altitude horizontal transport arrow ① in the figure; “water springs flow east, day and night without rest” indicates that surface water, spring water, or groundwater on land continuously flows eastward toward lower areas and the ocean, corresponding to slope runoff ⑤ and underground/spring-water runoff ⑥ in the figure. Therefore the involved numbers combined are 156.
